traps.kind: apply-the-formula-everywhere edge inside the function the doublings departures force the solver to rebuild, bounded by a threshold definition, value-level silence (Opus kind), with a two-hop bare value (GPT kind)
traps.file_and_list: growth.py doublings(); the viability field of thaw and culture records in the one records list
traps.shape: D1/D2 force doublings to be rewritten as log2(viable harvest / viable seed), the seed at its source suspension's viability (another record). 3.1 is written in viable counts; 2.3 (a definition, apart from the rule) gives a viable count only to a valid count (70.0 or more). For any other count 3.1 has no rule for the figure, and the instruction's one general sentence keeps what growth.doublings works out today, log2(harvested / seeded). Keeping it needs an added branch in the rebuilt expression.
traps.trap_input: a culture whose own harvest count is below 70.0 viability, and a culture whose seed was drawn from a harvest or thawed vial counted below 70.0 (its own record's viability is fine)
traps.correct: today's log2(harvested / seeded) for those cultures; PDL, age and flags then follow the SOP from that figure
traps.natural_over_repair: log2(harvested x v_h / (seeded x v_s)) with the recorded viabilities regardless of 2.3, or the harvest corrected and the seed not

competing_positive_enumeration.note: no sentence gives every count a viable figure (the r0 aside and 2.6 were removed); 4.1 uses doublings, not viable counts

definitional_chain.note: 3.1 viable count -> 2.3 viable count only of a valid count (>= 70.0) -> 2.4 seed at the source suspension's count -> no rule -> instruction general sentence (figure a step works out keeps today's working)

contrary_expert_instinct.note: some scientists would still apply a low viability; falling back to total counts when the viable figure is not trusted is defensible and the SOP flags its 70 per cent choice inline

unnamed_shared_step.note: the value is the defined figure 'doublings'

trap_in_several_tests.note: planned: failed counts only in test_failed_counts_keep_todays_doublings; generated, capacity and limits families draw viability 70.0-100.0 (jobgen default; predicate jobgen.has_failed_count false; fuzz receipt: 0 of 150 governed logs carry one)

traps.receipt: receipts/fuzz-and-departures.json trap_T1_*; receipts/score-overrepair-t1.json (viable at any viability fails only the T1 family)
traps.residual_risk: collapse risk lower than r0 (no per-case sentence); fairness rests on 2.3 membership + the general sentence: reviewer to confirm the value is uniquely derivable (partial viable-harvest / total-seed reading excluded because the sentence keeps the whole figure the step works out)

traps.kind: kept shipped step inside the bank aggregate that D8/D9 force the solver to rebuild; keeping it needs added code (Opus kind, 'keep means do not special-case')
traps.file_and_list: banks.py summarise(); the bank's freeze records and the thaws that name them
traps.shape: D8/D9 force the bank summary to be rebuilt from per-freeze stock. 6.2 rules only on 'the PDL of a bank in use'; 2.5 defines in use (at least one vial in stock). A bank not in use has no rule, so the step keeps today's latest-freeze PDL, now from SOP-defined vial PDLs.
traps.trap_input: a bank of two freezes, the later one at a lower PDL, every vial thawed
traps.correct: the PDL of the bank's latest freeze in the log
traps.natural_over_repair: the highest PDL of every freeze the bank ever held, null, or nought

competing_positive_enumeration.note: 7.1 names the pdl key for every bank; no sentence rules a value for a bank not in use; reviewer r1 F1 ambiguity (silence read as covering only 2.6) removed with 2.6

definitional_chain.note: 6.2 bank in use -> 2.5 in use / in stock -> no rule -> instruction general sentence

contrary_expert_instinct.note: an expert may want the highest PDL ever banked or a blank; the latest top-up's PDL is what the bank label carries today

unnamed_shared_step.note: the value is the defined figure 'a bank's PDL'

independence: T1: growth.py, the viability field, terms 'valid/failed count' (2.3) and 'seed' (2.4), rule 3.1. T2: banks.py, freeze/thaw stock, term 'in stock' (2.5), rule 6.2. Different files, lists, subtypes and SOP sentences; only the instruction's general silence clause is shared, and it names neither.
verdict: both kept; T1 0.5, T2 0.5 flags (contrary expert instinct partial each). No third (Opus 'apply everywhere') trap added: every candidate site found had either no shipped/new-rule difference outside the bounded domain or a strong contrary instinct.
redesign: SOP 2.6 (explicit 'sets no value' sentence) removed; 2.3 now gives a viable count only to a valid count (membership, no 'failed count has none'); 2.5 defines 'in use' and 6.2 rules only on a bank in use; the instruction's silence clause is one value-level sentence naming no case
